name: colibri
description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
one_liner: Software that lets a single home computer run enormous AI chatbot models that normally need a data center, by cleverly shuffling data between disk, memory, and graphics card.
buyer: A hobbyist or small AI studio that wants to run cutting-edge open models privately on their own gaming PC instead of paying for cloud API access.
business_use_cases: A local IT consultant sells 'private AI in a box' desktop workstations to law firms and clinics that can't send client data to the cloud.
A YouTuber/reviewer builds a niche channel benchmarking which consumer GPU setups can run which giant models, monetized via affiliate hardware links.
A boutique hardware reseller bundles a pre-configured 'local LLM workstation' with Colibrì pre-installed, sold to AI enthusiasts.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell pre-configured 'local AI workstation' hardware bundles
Offer paid setup/tuning consulting for people trying to fit a specific model onto their hardware

steal_this: This weekend, benchmark three different consumer GPU configs running the same model through Colibrì, publish the results as a buyer's guide, and sell hardware affiliate links off the traffic.
